milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the lapis lazuli pillar (3 blocks tall at spawn-relative 8,1,8). max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walks to the pillar rather than just spotting it from spawn (~11.3 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the block when nearby, modeling that they have 'found' it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The emerald pillar (3 blocks tall at spawn-relative 17,1,15) is hidden behind a stone brick wall (14-16, 0-3, 13-16). max_distance=8 ensures the player has navigated around the wall — from the lapis pillar at (8,1,8) the emerald is ~11.4 blocks away, so the player must move closer. The wall blocks direct line-of-sight from spawn, forcing navigation around it. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the emerald block.
